audience: email marketers who run lists, newsletters and autoresponders in GetResponse

useCases.title: Look up a contact and see lists, tags and fields
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by email or name and reads campaign membership, tags, custom field values and engagement scoring.

useCases.title: Review mailing lists and their settings
useCases.text: The AI lists your campaigns (mailing lists) with their names and opens one to read the subscription confirmation settings.

useCases.title: Check recent newsletters and their status
useCases.text: The AI lists newsletters, filtered by subject, and opens one to read its status and send settings. You see what went out and what is still a draft.

useCases.title: Audit autoresponders, tags, custom fields and senders
useCases.text: The AI lists your autoresponders, tags, custom field definitions and verified from-fields. You get one view of how your account is set up.

useCases.title: Add, update or remove contacts
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact to a list, changes a contact's name, tags or custom fields, or deletes a contact. A new contact appears after a few minutes.
